##### Project general facts

7 Park Central by Meteora is a striking modern tower that rises 19 storeys, wrapped in a shimmering exterior of glass and stainless steel that catches the light beautifully at every hour. The building is home to a collection of fully furnished, ready-to-move-in residences, each one masterfully designed with distinguished interiors and finished to a standard that genuinely rewards a closer look. Oversized windows, generous high ceilings and multiple panoramic exposures fill every home with light, while gracious balconies and Juliet balconies open the living spaces out towards sweeping views over the community park and the skyline beyond.

Residents enjoy a wonderfully complete set of resident-only amenities, centred on a tranquil swimming pool pavilion framed by sun loungers, a poolside lounge and a gardenside lounge for quieter moments. The fully landscaped courtyard is a real highlight, with sculpted planters, integrated benches, a water feature, a shaded pagoda and barbecue stations that chefs and grillers will love. There is also a state-of-the-art fitness centre, an outdoor movie theatre for evenings under the stars, a colourful children's playroom and play area, an entertainment zone, dedicated parking floors and a retail level right at the base of the building.

Inside, the residences are defined by an intentionally restrained material palette that lets the quality of each finish speak for itself, beginning with wide plank white oak flooring laid throughout. The kitchens combine marble countertops and backsplashes with custom cabinetry, ample workspace and exquisite integrated lighting, creating a sleek and highly functional setting for cooking and entertaining. The bathrooms are designed for calm and restoration, with porcelain tiles spanning the floors and continuing into glass-enclosed showers, and solid-surface countertops paired with dark wood custom vanities and mirrors with integrated lighting.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a vibrant residential community in Dubai, known for its family-friendly environment and balanced mix of modern urban living and tranquil suburban ambiance. Situated in the heart of new Dubai, JVC offers a blend of villas, townhouses, and apartments, making it an attractive location for both families and young professionals. The area is designed to provide residents with a sense of community, with its wide range of amenities including parks, schools, and healthcare facilities, all within easy reach.

The architecture in JVC is a blend of traditional Arabian and modern styles, contributing to its unique charm. The community is well-connected to key areas of Dubai through major highways like Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it convenient for residents to commute to work, school, or entertainment hubs. The community's layout is thoughtfully planned, with lush green spaces, walking paths, and communal areas that encourage outdoor activities and social interaction.

In addition to residential options, JVC is home to a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and leisure facilities, ensuring that residents have everything they need close at hand. The ongoing development in the area continues to enhance its appeal, making JVC a sought-after location for those looking to experience a balanced lifestyle in the bustling city of Dubai.
